new_theorem: For every prime q>3, no binary fixed-Fourier equality mask of order 3q has q<d<2q.
combined_classification: At order N=3q, q>3 prime, a positive degree d is attainable exactly when d is in {1,3,q,3q}, equivalently d divides N.
essential_conditions: Original binary masks and exact fixed Fourier phases
Derived same-group graph is union of at most two cliques
Singleton components may have fiber weights zero, one, or two
Primitive and order-three row differences retained
remaining: Exact nonsharp optima and sharper gap rates
